words.English Meaning: to have been to / have visited
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 我去过中国两次，非常喜欢那里的文化。(Wǒ qùguo Zhōngguó liǎng cì, fēicháng xǐhuan nàli de wénhuà.) — I have been to China twice and really like the culture there.

words.English Meaning: to think over / to ponder / let me see
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 这件事情很重要，让我想一想再回答你。(Zhè jiàn shìqing hěn zhòngyào, ràng wǒ xiǎng yi xiǎng zài huídá nǐ.) — This matter is very important, let me think it over before answering you.

words.English Meaning: to keep one's word / to honor promises
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 我们说话算话，答应你的事情一定会办到。(Wǒmen shuōhuà suàn huà, dāying nǐ de shìqing yídìng huì bàndào.) — We keep our word; what we promised you will definitely be done.
夜晚的天空非常晴朗，能看见许多星星。(Yèwǎn de tiānkōng fēicháng qínglǎng, néng kànjiàn xǔduō xīngxing.) — The night sky is very clear, and many stars can be seen.
现在的年轻人充满创造力和活力。(Xiànzài de niánqīngrén chōngmǎn chuàngzàolì hé huólì.) — Young people today are full of creativity and vitality.
如果你有任何问题，可以随时问老师。(Rúguǒ nǐ yǒu rènhé wèntí, kěyǐ suíshí wèn lǎoshī.) — If you have any questions, you can ask the teacher anytime.
周末公园里有很多孩子们在草地上奔跑。(Zhōumò gōngyuán li yǒu hěn duō háizimen zài cǎodì shang bēnpǎo.) — On weekends, there are many children running on the grass in the park.
他去过世界上很多不同的国家旅行。(Tā qùguo shìjiè shang hěn duō bùtóng de guójiā lǚxíng.) — He has traveled to many different countries in the world.

words.English Meaning: terrible / bad / disastrous / what bad luck
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 太糟糕了，突然下大雨而我没带伞。(Tài zāogāo le, tūrán xià dàyǔ ér wǒ méi dài sǎn.) — How terrible, it suddenly rained hard and I didn't bring an umbrella.
多做善事和好事会让内心感到充实。(Duō zuò shànshì hé hǎoshì huì ràng nèixīn gǎndào chōngshí.) — Doing more charity and good deeds makes one feel fulfilled inside.
有时候坏事也能变成吸取教训的好机会。(Yǒushíhou huàishì yě néng biànchéng xīqǔ jiàoxun de hǎo jīhuì.) — Sometimes a bad thing can also turn into a good opportunity to learn a lesson.
超市里买了一些新鲜水果和蔬菜。(Chāoshì li mǎi le yìxiē xīnxiān shuǐguǒ hé shūcài.) — I bought some fresh fruit and vegetables at the supermarket.
我们从第一页开始认真复习。(Wǒmen cóng dì-yī yè kāishǐ rènzhēn fùxí.) — We start reviewing diligently from page one.
医生们全力以赴减少疾病造成的死亡风险。(Yīshēngmen quánlì yǐ fù jiǎnshǎo jíbìng zàochéng de sǐwáng fēngxiǎn.) — Doctors go all out to reduce the risk of death caused by illness.
电影马上就要开始了，请大家安静。(Diànyǐng mǎshàng jiù yào kāishǐ le, qǐng dàjiā ānjìng.) — The movie is about to begin, please everyone be quiet.
我小时候最喜欢在夏天的晚上看星星。(Wǒ xiǎoshíhou zuì xǐhuan zài xiàtiān de wǎnshang kàn xīngxing.) — When I was a child, I liked looking at the stars on summer nights most.
父母教导他从小就要诚实善良。(Fùmǔ jiàodǎo tā cóngxiǎo jiù yào chéngshí shànliáng.) — His parents taught him to be honest and kind since childhood.
我很想去参加聚会，可是身体不太舒服。(Wǒ hěn xiǎng qù cānjiā jùhuì, kěshì shēntǐ bú tài shūfu.) — I want to go to the party, but I don't feel very well.

words.English Meaning: it's okay / no problem / nothing wrong
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 虽然不小心摔倒了，但他笑着说没事。(Suīrán bù xiǎoxīn shuāidǎo le, dàn tā xiàozhe shuō méishì.) — Although he accidentally fell, he smiled and said it was okay.

words.English Meaning: still want / also need / need more
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 服务员，我们这桌还要一壶热水。(Fúwùyuán, wǒmen zhè zhuō hái yào yì hú rèshuǐ.) — Waiter, our table still needs another pot of hot water.

words.English Meaning: what should we do? / how to handle this?
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 赶不上末班车了，我们现在该怎么办？(Gǎnbushàng mòbānchē le, wǒmen xiànzài gāi zěnme bàn?) — We can't catch the last bus, what should we do now?

words.English Meaning: passable / not bad / so-so / can still
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 这部新电影情节还可以，值得一看。(Zhè bù xīn diànyǐng qíngjié hái kěyǐ, zhídé yí kàn.) — The plot of this new movie is pretty decent, worth watching.
周末我已经安排了和朋友一起去郊游。(Zhōumò wǒ yǐjīng ānpái le hé péngyou yìqǐ qù jiāoyóu.) — I have already arranged an outing with friends for the weekend.

words.English Meaning: still / yet / had better / or (in questions)
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 外面天色已晚，你还是早点回家吧。(Wàimiàn tiānsè yǐ wǎn, nǐ háishi zǎodiǎn huíjiā ba.) — It is already late outside, you had better head home early.

words.English Meaning: just got home / arrived home just now
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 我刚刚到家，准备洗个热水澡休息。(Wǒ gānggang dào jiā, zhǔnbèi xǐ ge rèshuǐzǎo xiūxi.) — I just got home and am ready to take a hot bath to rest.
